About the role:
Hi there! We're seeking a strategic and operationally excellent Senior Manager, Revenue Operations & Sales Commission to own the design, implementation, and governance of our enterprise sales compensation program. This senior-level individual contributor role reports to the VP of Revenue Operations and serves as the architect and steward of compensation strategy across our diverse go-to-market organization.
You'll partner with GTM Leadership, Finance, and People Operations to build world-class compensation programs that attract talent, drive the right behaviors, and align with business objectives. You'll manage the full lifecycle of compensation—from design through implementation, compliance, analytics, and continuous improvement—across Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Sales Leaders, Partner Managers, Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers and other functions on variable compensation plans.
Note: This role focuses on compensation design and operations. Our Finance team manages commission accounting and invoice processing in Xactly.

What You Will Do
Compensation Strategy & Design
• 
Own the strategic design of annual sales compensation programs for all eligible roles and adjust for market conditions, competitive landscape, and business priorities
• 
Benchmark compensation against market data and peer software companies; conduct pay equity analysis and recommend adjustments to ensure competitiveness and fairness
• 
Design commission structures, accelerators, quotas, and incentive mechanics that drive desired sales behaviors and align with revenue goals
• 
Design and own SPIFF and other incentive programs outside of the official incentive plan
• 
Lead cross-functional design reviews with Sales, Finance, and executive leadership to validate programs before launch
Program Implementation & Operations
• 
Manage the end-to-end program launch calendar; coordinate cross-functional efforts and communicate timelines, changes, and deadlines to stakeholders
• 
Build and maintain the primary source of truth for all compensation program documentation, including plan documents, commission schedules, quota assignments, and policy guidelines
• 
Configure compensation programs in Xactly and SFDC; validate data integrity, test calculations, and ensure system configurations reflect approved plan design
• 
Develop training materials and lead training sessions for sales teams on compensation plan mechanics, commission calculations, and incentive rules
Governance & Compliance
• 
Ensure compensation programs comply with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies across all geographies where we operate
• 
Manage exceptions, disputes, and appeals related to commissions, quotas, and incentive payouts; work with VP RevOps, Finance and HR to resolve efficiently and fairly
• 
Maintain audit trails and documentation for all material compensation decisions and changes
Analytics & Reporting
• 
Build dashboards and reports to monitor role based performance metrics, compensation spend, payout distributions, plan attainment, and ROI on incentive investments. Including SPIFF reporting metrics
• 
Conduct post-program analysis (win/loss, attainment distribution, program metrics) and deliver insights to leadership on plan effectiveness
• 
Recommend program adjustments mid-year based on market shifts, business performance, and feedback from sales leaders
Cross-functional Collaboration
• 
Partner with VP of RevOps to align compensation with business strategy and sales priorities; maintain regular feedback loops with Sales Leaders
• 
Work directly with Commission Accounting on attainment data, payouts, calculations and discrepancies
• 
Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and year-end reporting of incentive spend
• 
Work with People Operations on equity, total rewards strategy, and talent retention initiatives
• 
Communicate compensation strategy and changes to the broader organization with clarity and confidence

What You Will Bring to the Role
Required Qualifications
• 
8+ years of progressive experience in sales compensation, incentive design, or related revenue operations roles (within software, SaaS, or enterprise sales environments preferred)
• 
Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing compensation programs for multiple sales roles and structures
• 
Advanced proficiency with sales compensation platforms (Xactly, Anaplan, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); strong data analysis and Excel skills
• 
Deep understanding of CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and comfort configuring objects, fields, and reporting for incentive programs
• 
Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities
• 
Excellent communication and presentation skills; comfort translating complex compensation concepts for diverse audiences (sales teams, executives, finance, HR)
• 
Meticulous attention to detail; strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
• 
Familiarity with GDPR, CCPA, and other employment law considerations affecting compensation (particularly for global organizations)
Preferred Qualifications
• 
Experience managing compensation programs across multiple geographic regions with different regulatory requirements
• 
Background in financial analysis, FP&A, or accounting; understanding of revenue recognition impacts on compensation timing
• 
Exposure to Customer Success, Services, or other non-traditional sales comp models
• 
Certification in compensation (e.g., WorldatWork CECP, GRP) or related HR disciplines
•

About the Role
We are building an AI Security and Governance capability and need an AI Security Analyst to be the front line for detecting, investigating, and containing risk across every AI tool, agent, and model touching AlphaSense's environment. 
You will monitor enterprise AI usage end to end, hunt for unauthorized ("shadow") AI and rogue agent activity, and turn raw AI telemetry into triaged findings the security and governance team can act on. Working alongside the Automation Engineer, Data Analyst, and Director, you will be a primary contributor to the evidence base underpinning our ISO 42001 certification and our broader AI risk posture.
Key Responsibilities
AI Tool Discovery & Shadow AI Monitoring
Continuously monitor CASB/SWG, OAuth, and endpoint telemetry to discover unsanctioned AI tools, browser extensions, and API-level agents in use across the business. Classify findings by risk tier and escalate unauthorized deployments for containment.
Rogue Agent Detection & Investigation
Investigate alerts related to autonomous agents and AI-powered workflows (e.g., anomalous tool chains, unexpected data access, credential misuse) including threats such as OpenClaw and similar agent-based attack patterns. Document findings and drive remediation with the Automation Engineer and Identity teams.
AI Data Exfiltration Detection & DLP
Monitor DLP and AI usage logs for signs of sensitive data leaving the environment through AI tools (prompts, uploads, plugins, MCP connectors). Tune detection rules and validate that AI-specific DLP controls are operating as designed.
Developer AI Tool Governance
Monitor usage of developer-facing AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and similar) for policy compliance, credential exposure, and non-human identity risk. Partner with Engineering to ensure code-assist and agentic dev tools operate within approved guardrails.
AI Logging, Retention & Audit Support
Maintain and validate AI activity logging and data retention controls to ensure auditability. Assemble and organize evidence supporting ISO 42001 audits, EU AI Act readiness, and internal AI impact assessments.
Detection Tuning & Continuous Improvement
Analyze false positive/negative trends across AI security detections and recommend threshold and logic adjustments. Feed recurring patterns into the Automation Engineer's playbook backlog.
Cross-functional Collaboration
Partner with Security Operations, Identity, Legal, and AI/ML Engineering to align findings with existing incident response processes, and support the Director in preparing risk findings for governance council and executive reporting.
Who You Are
Basic Requirements 

• 3-5+ years in security analysis, SOC, or GRC analyst roles 

• Working knowledge of SIEM platforms (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google Chronicle) and DLP/CASB tooling 

• Understanding of AI/LLM risk concepts: prompt injection, data exfiltration via AI tools, model/agent misuse, shadow AI 

• Familiarity with non-human identity concepts (service accounts, API keys, OAuth tokens) and their security challenges 

• Understanding of threat detection logic (MITRE ATT exposure to MITRE ATLAS or OWASP LLM Top 10 a plus) 

• Comfortable reading and interpreting logs, API telemetry, and structured/unstructured investigation data Basic scripting or query proficiency (Python, SQL, or SPL/KQL) for investigation and reporting 

• Strong written documentation habits

• Ability to translate technical findings into clear, risk-based narratives Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Required AI Security Depth (must demonstrate genuine, applied experience in at least one of the following — not coursework, certifications, or familiarity alone)

• 
Hands-on AI/LLM risk testing or investigation: prompt injection testing, model/agent misuse investigation, or AI-specific data exfiltration analysis

• 
CASB/SWG-based application discovery: unsanctioned SaaS, browser extension, or shadow IT/shadow AI detection using tools such as Netskope, Zscaler, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Wiz, or similar

• 
Non-human identity investigation: API key, OAuth token, or service account misuse investigation and risk assessment (administration alone does not qualify — we're looking for investigative/risk experience)

• 
Agentic AI or MCP-based architecture exposure: from either the security or engineering side — e.g., securing, testing, or building agent tool-use pipelines (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, MCP servers)

Candidates should be prepared to describe a specific example — what they found, how they investigated it, and what the outcome was — rather than listing this as a resume skill.
Threat Detection Logic
• Understanding of MITRE ATT exposure to MITRE ATLAS or OWASP LLM Top 10 strongly preferred
Nice to Have

• Hands-on (not just conceptual) exposure to AI governance frameworks — ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act risk tiers — ideally through audit evidence collection or control testing (SOC 2, ISO, or similar)

• Direct experience with any of: Netskope, Zscaler, Wiz, Orca Security, Microsoft Purview, Abnormal Security, Bolster AI, or comparable AI-aware security platforms

• Exposure to ML-based anomaly detection or NLP-driven log analysis

• Certifications: Security+, CISSP (Associate), or AI-specific credentials (e.g., AI/ML security, OWASP AI, GIAC)
